captions.caption: A white truck with a red trailer is parked on a dirt road beside a harvested field.
The camera pans across a harvested field with several hay bales scattered about.
Wide rows of harvested crop residue are visible in the large, flat field.
The panning shot continues to reveal more of the harvested agricultural landscape.
Organized rows of straw stretch across the vast field under a clear sky.
The camera scans the expansive harvested farmland, showing the scale of the operation.
The view extends towards the horizon, showcasing the flat terrain of the field.
Rows of harvested grain lead the eye towards the back of the large field.
The camera captures the detailed texture of the straw left on the ground.
Distant farm buildings and silos appear on the horizon as the camera pans right.
A green field is seen adjacent to the brown, harvested grain field.
A combine harvester is visible working in the far distance across the field.
The camera finishes its pan, showing a dirt road on the right side of the field.
Grain is discharged from a green combine harvester into a red truck trailer.
A close-up shows grain flowing steadily from the harvester's auger into the truck.
The green combine harvester continues unloading its grain into the red trailer.
The harvested grain fills the trailer of the white truck labeled "Peterson Farms".
The combine harvester begins to move away after finishing the unloading process.
A green combine harvester drives through the harvested field, kicking up dust.
The harvester moves across the golden field, leaving a trail of straw and dust.
A green combine harvester is seen operating in the middle of a large field.
The harvester continues its path through the grain under a bright, sunny sky.
Another combine harvester is visible working in the distance of the vast field.
A second combine harvester comes into view on the right, approaching a truck.
The second combine harvester aligns itself with a red truck trailer in the field.
The harvester stops next to the red truck to begin unloading its grain.
A person in a purple shirt walks towards the back of the parked red truck.
The combine harvester is positioned next to the truck as the person reaches the trailer.
Transition to an aerial view of a large harvested field and the surrounding landscape.
The drone captures an expansive view of fields, roads, and distant farm buildings.
The aerial shot shows parallel rows of straw in a vast harvested field.
A red truck drives along a dirt road between different crop fields.
The drone flies over the geometric patterns created by the harvested rows.
A green field sits adjacent to the brown, harvested grain field.
A combine harvester appears as a small speck in the distance of the aerial view.
The drone flight continues, showcasing the immense scale of the agricultural land.
A crossroad between fields is visible from above with a truck parked nearby.
The aerial perspective highlights the boundary between different types of crops.
The camera pans back towards the golden, harvested section of the field.
Long parallel lines of harvested grain stretch across the flat landscape.
A single hay bale sits in the middle of a harvested row in the field.
The drone flies over the textured surface of the harvested grain field.
Sunlight illuminates the rows of golden straw from an elevated aerial view.
More hay bales come into view as the camera moves forward over the field.
The aerial shot captures a combine harvester working in a distant part of the field.
Farm buildings and trees are visible on the horizon in the drone footage.
The vastness of the prairie farmland is shown from a high altitude perspective.
The camera focuses on the wide expanse of a harvested wheat field.
A dirt road divides the fields, extending towards the clear, flat horizon.
The drone view shows the clear boundary between harvested and unharvested sections.
Intricate patterns left by harvesting machinery are clearly visible from above.
A combine harvester moves slowly across the golden landscape in the distance.
The aerial footage continues to showcase the scenic beauty of the farmland.
Several hay bales are scattered across the recently harvested field area.
The drone provides a bird's-eye view of the ongoing harvesting operations.
The flat horizon meets a clear blue sky above the extensive farmland.
Different shades of brown and green fields are visible from the aerial camera.
A combine harvester works in a distant part of the expansive agricultural field.
The camera flies over an area with flattened grain residue and straw.
The video shows the extensive harvested fields stretching far into the distance.
